title: Menang Pertama
notes: Source of truth for Episode 7 (rework). Crossbar clang hook into Pak Din's otai mind games. Azam's RM5 reply plants the salary gag. The first goal of the season is told in-scene: Jurulatih's press, Azam's read, Farid's finish. At full-time Bos talks about trust, not digits, and Azam refuses a raise until the trophy. Debt drops RM331,500 -> RM316,500.

scenes.name: Act 1 — Otai Mind Games
scenes.visual: Hook: a shot whistles past the post and clangs the crossbar at frame 0. Pak Din — Otai Kampung's slow, condescending veteran — mocks the RM5 wage bill. Azam answers with the season's running gag: blocks are free. Pak Din promises to wait for a mistake.
scenes.sfx: bell clang on the crossbar at frame 0; kick transient; crowd murmur.

events.note: First cut within the hook window.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Otai Kampung FC. Kaki lambat, mulut laju.
lines.translation: Otai Kampung FC. Slow legs, fast mouths.

lines.speaker: PAK DIN
lines.text: Gaji lima ringgit? Kasut aku pun lebih mahal, bro.
lines.translation: Five-ringgit salary? My boots cost more, bro.

lines.speaker: AZAM
lines.text: Gaji aku lima ringgit. Blok aku free. Nak rasa?
lines.translation: My salary is five ringgit. My blocks are free. Want a taste?

lines.speaker: PAK DIN
lines.text: Otai tak panas. Otai tunggu korang silap.
lines.translation: Old lions stay calm. We wait for your mistake.

scenes.name: Act 2 — Gol Pertama Musim
scenes.visual: Jurulatih orders the high press. Pak Din plays the easy pass; Azam reads it five steps early, cuts it out and calls Farid's name. One touch into the top corner — net ripple, camera shake, crowd roar. Azam's cheeky one-liner lands on the dazed veteran.
scenes.sfx: press shout; intercept scuff; kick + net.wav on the goal; crowd-medium roar.

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.translation: Push up! Press! Force the mistake!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Pak Din pass biasa. Azam dah baca lima langkah awal.
lines.translation: Pak Din plays the easy pass. Azam read it five steps early.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.translation: One touch… straight into the top corner.

lines.speaker: FARID
lines.translation: FINALLY! First goal of the season!

scenes.name: Act 3 — Duit Percaya & Gaji Azam
scenes.visual: Full-time on the touchline: the KEK MAJU board glows over a packed gate. Bos holds a fist of ticket stubs — trust money, not pocket change. Jurulatih teases about Azam wanting a raise; Bos reveals Azam refused one until the trophy. DebtTickerHUD rolls GREEN RM331,500 -> RM316,500.
scenes.sfx: long whistle; coin/cash shuffle (pen-tap pattern); green HUD bell.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Whistle panjang. Gerbang penuh. Kek Maju menyala.
lines.translation: Full-time whistle. Packed gate. The Kek Maju board lights up.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Duit tiket ni... orang datang sebab percaya kita.
lines.translation: This gate money… people come because they believe.

lines.speaker: JURULATIH
lines.text: Bos, Azam tanya bila gaji dia naik.
lines.translation: Boss, Azam asked when his salary goes up.

lines.speaker: BOS
lines.text: Dia kata — lepas juara, baru ambil duit.
lines.translation: He said — after we're champions, then he takes money.

scenes.visual: Standard black Buluh FC / EPISOD 7 card. No CTA.
